parsed.internal_thinking: I am one Brick away from building a settlement on Node 7 (the Brick port), which is vital for my game. I have 3 Wood, 1 Wheat, 1 Sheep, and 1 Ore. I produce Brick on Hex 13 (a 10), but the recent roll was a 4. Alice has 1 Wood, 1 Wheat, and 2 Sheep; she cannot help me with Brick. Bob has 2 Wood, 3 Wheat, and 1 Sheep. Since no one has Brick to trade and I don't have enough resources to trade with the bank (4:1) yet, buying a development card is the most productive use of my Ore, Sheep, and Wheat. This keeps my momentum toward Largest Army or potentially pulls a Year of Plenty/Monopoly for the Brick I need.
parsed.note_to_self: I am still one Brick short for the Node 7 settlement. Buying a Dev Card to utilize Ore/Sheep/Wheat. Bob's Brick 6 remains blocked.
parsed.say_outloud: Well, looks like the bricks are as dry as the desert right now. I'll just have to see what else I can find in the deck.
